site_name: Former Gasworks Site, Rick Roberts Way, Stratford, Newham, London, E15 2GN
description: Full Planning Application for demolition, site clearance, remediation of the site and groundworks to facilitate redevelopment and change of use of former Stratford Gasworks for residential development, comprising 245 dwellings (Class C3 Use) and associated infrastructure; access; car and cycle parking; engineering works; new public realm/open space; partial demolition of boundary wall on Abbey Lane (a Non-Designated Heritage Asset); and works to the existing Pressure Reduction Station and gasholder voids, with the Pressure Reduction Station to be retained for use.
